verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an official remote MCP server with read-only and read-write SQL tools (query_rw), schema exploration, Guides, and read-only restriction options. It also ships an official local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck) for local DuckDB and self-hosted setups, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server.
